# Dell Area-51 external-monitor freeze fix — SRC-0172

## Source

https://www.dell.com/support/kbdoc/en-pf/000303362/alienware-area-51-laptops-temporarily-freeze-plugging-or-unplugging-external-monitors

## What it proves

dGPU mode could freeze 5-30 seconds on monitor connect/disconnect; Dell driver 32.0.15.9202 A01 or later resolves it

## Notes

Fix existence shows active support but also prevents calling platform history issue-free
